title: Semantics Extension
description: STAC Semantics Extension: concepts from published vocabularies that describe what a band, data cube variable or dimension, table column or single-variable asset measures. Applies to STAC Items and Collections.

type.$comment: Catalogs are not in scope: they describe no variables.

allOf.$comment: No fields at the top level of Items and Collections: dataset-level classification belongs to the Themes extension.

oneOf.$comment: STAC Items. Item properties may contain bands, data cube variables and dimensions and table columns, but no fields of their own.
STAC Collections. The top level may contain bands, data cube variables and dimensions and table columns, but no fields of its own.

summaries.$comment: Summaries describe Item properties, which cannot have fields of this extension.

sem:concepts.title: Concepts
sem:concepts.description: Concepts that describe the variable, band, column, dimension or asset.

concept.title: Concept Reference

uri.title: Concept URI
uri.description: Identifier of the concept, as published by its vocabulary. Compared as an exact string.

role.title: Role
role.description: What part of the variable the concept describes. Roles other than variable and unit follow the I-ADOPT framework.

oneOf.title: Variable
oneOf.description: The concept is the variable as a whole, for example a CF standard name or an I-ADOPT variable (I-ADOPT `Variable`).

oneOf.title: Property
oneOf.description: The concept is the characteristic of the object of interest that is observed, for example mole fraction (I-ADOPT `hasProperty`).

oneOf.title: Object of interest
oneOf.description: The concept is the entity whose property is observed, for example methane (I-ADOPT `hasObjectOfInterest`).

oneOf.title: Matrix
oneOf.description: The concept is the entity in which the object of interest is contained, for example air for methane (I-ADOPT `hasMatrix`).

oneOf.title: Context object
oneOf.description: The concept is an entity that gives background information about the object of interest (I-ADOPT `hasContextObject`).

oneOf.title: Constraint
oneOf.description: The concept is a qualifier that confines another component to a particular state, for example "dissolved" (I-ADOPT `hasConstraint`).

oneOf.title: Statistical modifier
oneOf.description: The concept is a statistical measure applied to the property, for example a maximum (I-ADOPT `hasStatisticalModifier`).

oneOf.title: Unit
oneOf.description: The concept is the unit of the values. Not an I-ADOPT role.

match.title: Match
match.description: How closely the concept fits what the data represent, following the SKOS mapping properties.

oneOf.title: Exact match
oneOf.description: The concept is the same as what the values represent (SKOS `exactMatch`).

oneOf.title: Close match
oneOf.description: The concept is nearly the same as what the values represent, but not formally identical (SKOS `closeMatch`).

oneOf.title: Broad match
oneOf.description: The concept is broader than what the values represent (SKOS `broadMatch`).

oneOf.title: Narrow match
oneOf.description: The concept is narrower than what the values represent (SKOS `narrowMatch`).

oneOf.title: Related match
oneOf.description: The concept is related to what the values represent in another way (SKOS `relatedMatch`).

scheme.title: Concept Scheme
scheme.description: The vocabulary (concept scheme) the concept belongs to.

id.title: Notation
id.description: The concept's notation or code within the scheme.

^[a-z0-9_-]+:.$comment: Fields that other extensions add to Concept References carry their prefix.

concept.description: A reference to a concept in a published vocabulary or ontology, and how it relates to what the values represent.

iri.$comment: The pattern requires a scheme for validators that do not check formats.

fields.$comment: Places where the fields are allowed. Unknown fields with the prefix of this extension are rejected.

noFields.$comment: Places where no fields of this extension are allowed.

variables.$comment: Objects that each describe one variable: Band Objects, data cube variables and dimensions, and table columns.

asset.$comment: Assets, Item Asset Definitions and asset templates: the fields are allowed on the asset and on the variables it contains.

container.$comment: Item properties and Collection top level: the fields are allowed on the variables they contain, not on the object itself.
